name: Little Tree | 200mg Gummies | Blue Razz
description:
4 Gummies | 50MG Each | Distillate

Our Blue Razz Distillate Gummies are crafted for straightforward relief with a punch of tart, juicy flavor. Infused with premium cannabis distillate, each gummy delivers 50MG of potent, consistent THC for a classic edible experience.

With a sweet-tart blue raspberry profile and a reliable chew, this gummy is built for those who value comfort, ease, and flavor that lasts.

Whether you’re winding down after work or relaxing into the weekend—this gummy is your easygoing go-to.
